desc: Create c-utils/treegen/ module (TreeGen.h + TreeGen.cpp, namespace treegen): seeded 32-bit PRNG, TreeGenConfig (per-level children/angle/length/radius/taper/twist/gnarliness, radialSegs, startFrac, trunk color, leaf strategy NONE/BLOBS/CONES/FAN), recursive branch-skeleton loop (per-section taper, twist, 1/sqrt(radius) gnarl perturbation, upward force pull, child enqueue at randomized height/radial offset), internal triangle-soup primitives (oriented cone band, sphere blob, cone stack) with the fixed mbCone winding/normal rules, tip-leaf emitters (blobs with radius/pos jitter, cone stacks, acacia fan clamped y<=0.9), unit-height + kCanopyFactor lateral clamping, neutral 48 B Vertex/Mesh output; per-species configs for conifer(4)/deciduous(4)/acacia(3)/dead_tree(2)/shrub(4) within the plan's tri budgets
result: c-utils/treegen/{TreeGen.h,TreeGen.cpp}: mulberry32 PRNG, genealogy-seeded skeleton (branchSeed = mix(parentSeed, child)), cone band/sphere/cone-stack primitives replicating the fixed mbCone winding (u x v = -axis frame, single b0->t1 diagonal, weighted per-segment normals), BLOBS/CONES/FAN emitters with maxTris budget guard, post-gen normalize (minY->0, maxY->1) + maxRadius xz clamp; verified: 17 variants bit-deterministic, differ across seeds, tri budgets (400/600/400/300/200) and lateral caps hold, 200-seed sweep all non-degenerate

desc: Wire treegen into the merged mesh: azgaarPropMeshBuild(void) -> azgaarPropMeshBuild(u32 seed) (seed at the azgaarPropsInit call site), add kSpeciesVariantCount[AZGAAR_PROP_COUNT] table (4/4/3/2/4 for the five species, 1 elsewhere), loop buildMesh over variants calling treegen with seed = mapSeed ^ (species * C) ^ v and a ~30-line adapter copying treegen::Mesh rows into the 52 B AzgaarPropVertex layout (normal.w/color.w paddings) fed to buildRangeInto, existing builders unchanged for other species, extend validateMesh log with per-variant tri counts and build wall-time (target < 50 ms)
result: azgaarPropMeshBuild(u32 mapSeed) + kSpeciesVariantCount (grass filled with runtime count at build) + kSpeciesLateralCap (0.55/0.80/0.70/0.45/0.90; dead_tree and shrub use documented per-species caps since their old kCanopyFactor 0.12/0.0 are gate params, not mesh extents); treeGenToBuilder adapter (normal.w=0, color passthrough incl. brown trunk); 31 ranges, validateMesh PASS with per-variant tri line, build 1.4-3.7 ms (< 50 ms); old conifer/deciduous/acacia/dead_tree/shrub builders removed, *_FAR + rest untouched

desc: Extend ENGINE_AZGAAR_PROPS_MESH_DUMP in AzgaarPropMesh.cpp to dump one OBJ per (species, variant) to /tmp/azgaar_props_<species>_<v>.obj and eyeball all 17 variant dumps: distinct silhouettes, upright trunks, no flipped faces, tops at y<=1, lateral extent within the species kCanopyFactor
